# RangeIQ

> RangeIQ is a poker education and training tool for live cash games ($1/$2–$5/$10).
> Players study between sessions against 9 opponent types using a simplified
> node-locking engine, plain-English "IQ Reasoning," and bet sizing in real dollars.
> It is not a gambling product and not for use during live play.

Key facts:

- Product: RangeIQ (also written "RangeIQ Poker"). App: https://app.rangeiqpoker.com — runs in the browser, no install.
- Category: educational software — like chess training software, for live No-Limit Hold'em cash games.
- The 9 opponent types: Nit, TAG, LAG, Young Aggro, Loose Passive, Calling Station, Maniac, Recreational, Unknown/Mixed.
- What makes it different from GTO solvers: a solver gives one balanced answer against a perfect opponent; RangeIQ trains the adjustment that profits against the specific opponent type across the table, stated in dollars with the reasoning written out.
- Pricing: Free tier (unlimited preflop analysis, 2 postflop spots/day, limited opponent types); Pro $14.99/month or $119/year.
- A Between the Cards product by IQ Digital Holdings LLC. Founder: Kenneth Jayne. Users 18+.
